Jajjaka
Bud. ins.. poet; composed Shergadh ins.. of Sāmanta Devadatta, A.
, p. 547; Ind. Ant. XIV. p.. 45-8. See Epi. Ind. XIX. App. p. 5. XXVI. p. 152 fn. 34.

Jajjulla
ins.. poet; son of Padmanābha; a. of copper plate ins.. of Govindarāja d. 800 A. D. See Epi. Ind. XXVI. p. 255.

Jajjhaṭa,_Jejjaṭa
or jaijjaTa pupil of Vāgbhaṭa; ref. to Bhaṭṭāra Haricandra (a. of C. on Carakasam3hitā). Ref. to in a.dhyānaśloka on Vāgbhaṭa.
--C. Nirantarapadavyākhyā on Carakasam3hitā. See NCC. VI. p. 397b.
Pt.. Motilal Banarasidas, Lahore.

Jājala
a school of Av. ref. to by Pāṇini
. See Bhagavaddatta, Vaidik vāṅmay kā itihās Vol. I. p.. 225 an. 229.

Jājali
another name of Ujjvaladatta (a. of C. on Uṇādisūtras).
See NCC. II. p.. 287a an. 294a.
